p.i: Celsitudinis Tuæ Zeli gloriam, & vel supremis titulis prorogabit famam, quod tot fideles animas per cau-sam religionis extorrium, & imbellium avicularum instar nidis suis excussarum, hinc inde palantium, & à mundo propter solam intemeratam in Jesum fidem pro σκυβάλοις habitarum, expansò Clementiæ Tuæ sinu, excipis, foves, promoves, efficisque denique, ut tot malis, quorum seriem formasque posteritas omnis stupebit, conflictantes, & jam pene fractos non pœniteat, Patrios Lares tenerrime aliàs dilectos, charitates, fortunas, quibus haud pœnitendis multi abundaverant, denique cuncta, quæ caro in delitiis habet, jactasse, solasque animas suas uni Christo Domino suo sacratas pro spoliis retulisse. Quanta ergo in Cœlis merces Munificentiæ huic, &, quod majus est, veræ fidei erga Christum, & Charitatis erga Sanctos piissimæ testificationi repositæ Te manebit! Quàm irrigua benedictionum Divinarum

page.notes: The Greek word σκυβάλοις is transcribed as printed. Some words in the lower lines are faint; "irrigua" and "Quàm" are read with some uncertainty. The running title is printed in spaced capitals and is not a page number.
